headline: ONE VOTE FROM OBLIVION
text: In October 1962, the human race was one single vote away from total nuclear annihilation.

headline: 90 MILES FROM FLORIDA
text: U-2 spy planes revealed Soviet nuclear warheads just ninety miles off the coast of Florida — capable of vaporizing Washington in three minutes.
docket: U-2 RECONNAISSANCE · MEDIUM RANGE BALLISTIC MISSILES

headline: THE NAVAL STANDOFF
text: Kennedy deployed a naval blockade. The world held its breath as Soviet freighters sailed straight toward the quarantine line.
docket: US NAVY DESTROYER TASK FORCE · ATLANTIC

headline: THE MAN WHO SAID NO
text: Deep underwater, Soviet submarine B-59 prepared to fire a nuclear torpedo. Two senior officers approved. One man, Vasili Arkhipov, said NO.

headline: THE LOGIC OF TERROR
text: This is Realism's darkest truth: peace was not preserved by moral treaties, but by the absolute certainty of Mutually Assured Destruction.
